reply_text:
I answered Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on **November 3, 2025**.

Two sources give that date. Moss's Coastal digest of 2025-11-02 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own cutover recap from Dec 8 also says the official handoff was Nov 3.

The recap adds that Bettina kept running the account day to day through Nov 21 for the terminal cutover. Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 22 if her coverage tracker needs the date coverage actually moved.
